basic_info.description: In prestigious Russian Hill just 1 block from one of the most delicious and vibrant neighborhoods in SF... North Beach, this rarely available residence offers an unparalleled lifestyle of walkability, culture, & convenience. Downtown, the Piers, Russian Hill, Washington Square are steps away. Greeted inside by soaring ceilings that amplify the grandeur of every room combined with original period details whisper of timeless elegance, while thoughtful modern updates seamlessly blend classic charm with contemporary comfort. The expansive eat-up island kitchen with sleek stainless steel appliances, is a culinary havenwhether you're crafting a gourmet meal or savoring a morning espresso before strolling to one of the city's finest cafes. And don't miss the huge pantry! In-home laundry adds convenience, while a huge deeded storage room in the basement ensures room for effortless organization. Outside, a charming, protected shared garden offers a rare urban retreata tranquil oasis in the heart of the city. This exclusive TIC property consists of just two other units & Fractional TIC financing available. Eligible for condo conversion when the SF conversion lottery reopens. Parking garage just 1 block away. Seller open to PREPAID garage parking garage for 1 year.
